Implement HTTP client + collectors + normalize for sdr v2 at /Users/apple/Documents/office/SDDAndAIProgramming/v2 using strict TDD. Do NOT copy from v1/src or v1/tests — rewrite from contracts in specs/design.md and v2/HANDOVER.md.

## Hard rules
- Only edit/commit files under v2/
- Commit pattern: `test: [T-00x] 红 — …` then `feat: [T-00x] 绿 — …`
- cwd for pnpm: /Users/apple/Documents/office/SDDAndAIProgramming/v2
- Use existing: src/errors.ts, src/clock.ts, src/types.ts, src/config.ts, store layer
- Add undici as devDependency for MockAgent

## T-005 http.ts
Create src/http.ts + tests/http.test.ts:
- requestJson(url, {method, headers, body, timeoutMs, token?})
- Retry exactly 3 times with delays 1s/2s/4s ONLY for 408/429/5xx and network errors; NOT for 400/401/403/404
- Injectable sleep for tests (or fake timers)
- Mask tokens in logs (>8 chars)
- **paginate**: async function paginatePages<T>({ fetchPage, maxPages=20 }) where fetchPage(page) returns { items: T[], hasNext: boolean }; if hasNext after maxPages throw SdrError SDR-E104 — do NOT return partial results

## T-006 GitHub collector
src/collectors/github.ts + tests + fixtures
- collectGithub({ repo, since, until, token, clock, http? }): Promise<Event[]>
- Map 401→E101, 403+rate limit→E102, timeout→E103, pagination overflow→E104
- Use shared paginate from http
- occurredAt as Date; dedupeKey later by normalize — collector may set temporary key or call buildDedupeKey
- Fixture: small commits JSON; test overflow with mocked pages

## T-007 Feishu
src/collectors/feishu.ts
- Status map: completed/done → kind task_done; unknown → still Event with title
- Auth fail → E201; missing fields → E202
- Use http + paginate where applicable

## T-008 local
src/collectors/local.ts
- Scan directory by mtime in [since, until); skip .git, node_modules, dist, data; absolute paths; no symlinks follow

## T-009 manual
src/collectors/manual.ts
- createManualEvent({ text, ref, memberId, runId, clock }) — empty/whitespace rejected
- source='manual', kind='note'; link note handled at generate time

## T-010 normalize
src/collectors/normalize.ts
- buildDedupeKey(sourceId, occurredAt, memberId, clock) using dayKey
- dedupe(events): same dedupeKey keep isPrimary or first; sort by occurredAt asc
- CS-19: same commit across UTC day boundary → same key when dayKey same

## ESLint
When done, ensure generator cannot import collectors later — for now optional.
Ban business new Date except clock (already set).

## Verify
pnpm test tests/http.test.ts tests/collectors
All must pass. Also pnpm typecheck.

## Return
Commits list, test summary, file list.
</user_query>
